1.web: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
1.asv: I love thee, O Jehovah, my strength.

2.web: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
2.asv: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in whom I will take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

3.web: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
3.asv: I will call upon Jehovah, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.

4.web: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
4.asv: The cords of death compassed me, And the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

5.web: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
5.asv: The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.

6.web: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
6.asv: In my distress I called upon Jehovah, And cried unto my God: He heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry before him came into his ears.

7.web: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
7.asv: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations also of the mountains quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.

8.web: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
8.asv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.

9.web: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
9.asv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And thick darkness was under his feet.

10.web: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
10.asv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, he soared upon the wings of the wind.

11.web: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
11.asv: He made darkness his hiding-place, his pavilion round about him, Darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

12.web: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
12.asv: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, Hailstones and coals of fire.

13.web: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
13.asv: Jehovah also thundered in the heavens, And the Most High uttered his voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.

14.web: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.
14.asv: And he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yea, lightnings manifold, and discomfited them.

15.web: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
15.asv: Then the channels of waters appeared, And the foundations of the world were laid bare, At thy rebuke, O Jehovah, At the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

16.web: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
16.asv: He sent from on high, he took me; He drew me out of many waters.

17.web: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
17.asv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, And from them that hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

18.web: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
18.asv: They came upon me in the day of my calamity; But Jehovah was my stay.

19.web: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
19.asv: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

20.web: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.
20.asv: Jehovah hath rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

21.web: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
21.asv: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not wickedly departed from my God.

22.web: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
22.asv: For all his ordinances were before me, And I put not away his statutes from me.

23.web: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
23.asv: I was also perfect with him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.

24.web: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
24.asv: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

25.web: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
25.asv: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; With the perfect man thou wilt show thyself perfect;

26.web: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
26.asv: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; And with the perverse thou wilt show thyself froward.

27.web: For you will save the afflicted people, but the haughty eyes you will bring down.
27.asv: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; But the haughty eyes thou wilt bring down.

28.web: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
28.asv: For thou wilt light my lamp: Jehovah my God will lighten my darkness.

29.web: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
29.asv: For by thee I run upon a troop; And by my God do I leap over a wall.

30.web: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
30.asv: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.

31.web: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,
31.asv: For who is God, save Jehovah? And who is a rock, besides our God,

32.web: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
32.asv: The God that girdeth me with strength, And maketh my way perfect?

33.web: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
33.asv: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet: And setteth me upon my high places.

34.web: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
34.asv: He teacheth my hands to war; So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.

35.web: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
35.asv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation; And thy right hand hath holden me up, And thy gentleness hath made me great.

36.web: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
36.asv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.

37.web: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. Neither will I turn again until they are consumed.
37.asv: I will pursue mine enemies, and overtake them; Neither will I turn again till they are consumed.

38.web: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
38.asv: I will smite them through, so that they shall not be able to rise: They shall fall under my feet.

39.web: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
39.asv: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

40.web: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
40.asv: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.

41.web: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
41.asv: They cried, but there was none to save; Even unto Jehovah, but he answered them not.

42.web: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
42.asv: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.

43.web: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
43.asv: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; Thou hast made me the head of the nations: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

44.web: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
44.asv: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me; The foreigners shall submit themselves unto me.

45.web: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their close places.
45.asv: The foreigners shall fade away, And shall come trembling out of their close places.

46.web: Yahweh lives; and blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
46.asv: Jehovah liveth; and blessed be my rock; And exalted be the God of my salvation,

47.web: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
47.asv: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And subdueth peoples under me.

48.web: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
48.asv: He rescueth me from mine enemies; Yea, thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.

49.web: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
49.asv: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the nations, And will sing praises unto thy name.

50.web: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his seed, forever more.
50.asv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.
